messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "store securely out of sight and reach of children"
set: ["store securely out of sight and reach of children", "keep out of reach of children and pets", "keep out of the reach of children", "store at room temperature away from moisture and heat and out of reach of children", "keep this and all medicines out of the reach of children", "keep all pens, vials, needles, and syringes out of reach of children", "keep out of light", "store away from children", "rule out other causes of hair thinning", "store between 4°C and 30°C (39°F and 86°F)", "store between 15°C and 30°C (59°F and 86°F)", "get your prescription refilled before you run out of medicine completely", "weight in children and teenagers", "store at room temperature away from moisture and heat", "store tablets and capsules at room temperature away from moisture and heat", "monitor height and weight in children and adolescents regularly"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
